_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for nerf-when, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). gists: a stratagem's one-line summary (the app's own words: its EFFECT shortened, its WHEN/TARGET condition kept, nothing added); def: its When targeted line; both AI-written (Claude, 24 Oct 2026) with the fingerprint (gistOf, defOf) of the text they were written from, so a changed source text fails the gate's fingerprints step. mod: a stratagem's weapon footnote (hand). rules: a detachment rule's Damage-tab calcMods (hand). units: per unit entry, its abilities' When targeted lines (def, AI-written, with defOf), its weapon footnotes (mods), notes on its abilities (notes: Supreme Commander's, as Ghazghkull Thraka's), its auras (only what GW tags (Aura), Core Rules 22.01) and stats values a rule of the list gives that New Recruit's export does not show. Each is a judgement verify/helpers.js lists for sign-off.

assault-brethren/duty-in-death.gist: Fight phase, an enemy unit targets your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit: when a model of it is destroyed before your unit has been selected to fight, roll one D6 (+1 if the assault doctrine is active for it); on a 4+ that model is removed only when your unit has fought or at the end of the phase.
assault-brethren/duty-in-death.def: Fight phase, before it has been selected to fight: a destroyed model stays on a D6 of 4+ (+1 with the assault doctrine active) until it has fought or the end of the phase

marneus-calgar-wardens-of-ultramar-blade.why: Codex Adept (Marneus Calgar): the doctrines are active for this unit, the whole attached unit (19.04); Bladeguard: one of its two effects, once per turn.

Unyielding in the Face of the Foe.def: +1 to save rolls while it is controlling an objective

impulsor.why: Shield Dome: "This unit has 5+ InSv." BSData’s modifier gives it (the "+" mark names Shield Dome); New Recruit’s export shows none.

readings._about: The readings of this list's rows (docs/tables.md, Readings): by the row they read (a datasheet by name, an army or detachment rule, an enhancement), each { mods, aura, guard } in the row's order, with the fingerprint of the text each was read from (readOf; readBy:"derive" where verify/derive.js gives it from the words). verify/from-json.js gives each unit the readings of its rows in the order data.js resolves them, then the unit's own (units.<id>.mods / aura / guard; a name there stands for the rows' readings of that name, the list being the unit's whole list). A datasheet not here: data.js's row, else verify/derive.js's derived readings.
